requirement.description: The to_process module has issues with handling None values and invalid paths when initializing worker processes. Several tests fail with "TypeError: 'NoneType' object cannot be interpreted as an integer" related to process management.
requirement.contract: Fix the process initialization logic to properly handle cases where main_module_path is None or contains invalid characters. The init command should not crash when sys.modules['__main__'].__file__ is None or contains null bytes.

requirement.description: The process worker initialization fails when dealing with null bytes in paths, causing ValueError: embedded null byte in path errors.
requirement.contract: Ensure that when extracting the main module path, null bytes are properly validated and handled. The system should gracefully handle invalid paths without crashing.

requirement.description: Subprocess handling fails with None values in process parameters, particularly in the run_process function.
requirement.contract: Improve robustness of subprocess parameter handling to properly deal with None values for parameters like user, group, extra_groups, and umask.

requirement.description: Process worker initialization lacks proper error handling for invalid main module paths.
requirement.contract: Add validation for main_module_path in the process_worker function to prevent crashes when paths are invalid or contain null bytes.

requirement.description: Subprocess functions fail when handling parameters that are None or improperly typed.
requirement.contract: Ensure all subprocess functions properly validate and handle None parameters to prevent TypeError exceptions when passing these to underlying subprocess APIs.
